newsitem.title: USA: ADVISORY - KCBT amends Thanksgiving trading hours.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY - KCBT amends Thanksgiving trading hours.

text.p: The Kansas City Board of Trade said on Thursday that it has amended its trading schedule for the upcoming Thanksgiving holiday.

Under the new schedule, trading in KCBT Value Line and Mini Value Line futures and options will close at 1215 CST/1815 GMT on Friday, Nov. 29. Trading in those instruments was previously scheduled to close at 1315 CST/1915 GMT on Friday.
Trading in all KCBT contracts will be closed on Thursday, Nov. 28, in observance of Thanksgiving. The exchange will observe the following hours for trade on the days surrounding Thanksgiving:
Wheat Futures Close at 1210 Close at 1210
Wheat Options Close at 1215 Close at 1215
Natural Gas Futures Normal hours No trading
Natural Gas Options Normal hours No trading
Value Line Futures Normal hours Close at 1215
Value Line Options Normal hours Close at 1215
Mini Value Line Futures Normal hours Close at 1215
Mini Value Line Options Normal hours Close at 1215
